disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false or incomplete information in any matter pertaining to the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for any person to give false information or incomplete information in any matter pertaining to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resisting, impeding, or hindering the apiary inspector in discharge of duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or to resist, impede, or hinder the apiary inspector in the discharge of his or her duties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exposing combs, honey, frames, empty hives, or other appliances contaminated by infected material from diseased colonies
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Anyone exposing combs, honey, frames, empty hives, covers or bottom-boards, or tools, or other appliances contaminated by infected material from diseased colonies shall, upon conviction, be punished as provided in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, offering for sale, giving away, or otherwise transferring bees without a certificate of health
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall sell, offer for sale, give away, or otherwise transfer ownership of any bees, colony of bees, or queen bees without first receiving from the State Plant Board a certificate of health

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transporting bees in used hives or apiary equipment into the state without a certificate of health
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The transportation of bees in used hives or other apiary equipment into this state without a certificate of health by any person or by common carriers is expressly prohibited.

definition_quote.value: Pollination means the use of bees for the transfer of pollen in the production of agricultural crops
definition_quote.quote: "Pollination" means the use of bees for the transfer of pollen in the production of agricultural crops

citations.kind: duties of persons engaged in beekeeping

registration_required.quote: A person owning, leasing, or possessing bees within ten (10) days after coming into ownership or possession of bees or before moving bees from outside the State of Arkansas, shall file with the State Plant Board an application for registration.

colony_count_reporting_required.quote: the number of colonies of bees in each apiary owned by him or her or in his or her possession or under his or her control, together with such other information as may be required by the board.

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: The application shall set forth the exact location by legal description of the premises, together with the name of the owner or possessor of the apiary

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: It is the duty of all persons engaged in beekeeping to provide movable frames in all hives used by them to contain bees and to cause the bees in the hives to construct brood combs in the frames so that any of the frames may be removed from the hive without injuring other combs in the hive.

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: If an abandoned apiary is found upon inspection to be diseased, the board shall cause it to be immediately destroyed by burning.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: All bees in used hives or other apiary equipment which may be brought into the state from other states or other countries must be accompanied by a certificate of health issued by the official inspector of the state or country where they had been located.

import_certificate_validity_days.quote: shall be based on actual inspection of bees and material within ninety (90) days of the date of shipment.

regulated_diseases.quote: "Bee disease" means American and European foulbrood, sacbrood, bee paralysis, or any other disease or abnormal condition of the egg, larval, pupal, or adult stages of bees

disease_reporting_required.quote: Immediately upon detection of disease, anyone keeping bees shall treat and disinfect, or burn and bury in places where they shall remain undisturbed, combs and frames taken from diseased colonies

quarantine_authority.quote: All apiaries, bees, bee equipment, bee products, buildings, premises, and appliances where or on which American or European foulbrood is known to exist are declared to be under quarantine.

inspector_disinfection_required_after_in.quote: After inspection of infected bees or fixtures or after handling diseased bees and before leaving the premises or proceeding to any other apiary, the apiary inspector shall take such measures as shall prevent the spread of the disease by infected material adhering to his or her person or clothing or to any tools or appliances used by him or her which have come in contact with infected materials.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: the apiary inspector shall have, where any apiary is located or any bees, combs, or apiary appliances are kept, the authority to enter upon any private or public premises with right of access, ingress, and egress

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: No person shall sell, offer for sale, give away, or otherwise transfer ownership of any bees, colony of bees, or queen bees without first receiving from the State Plant Board a certificate of health issued not more than six (6) months before disposition.

apiary_minimum_distance_rule.quote: No person can place bees on property other than his or her own within three (3) miles of a previously registered area without the written permission of the registrant.
